title: Dappled Forest Mod
description: Recreates The upcoming "Dappled Forest" biome alongside abandoned camps and wool slabs and stairs!
body:
**Recreates The new "Dappled Forest" biome shown in the bonus minecraft live of 2026 that will come is 26.3**

The dappled forest is a new cozy biome, adding new trees and blocks!

![The Dappled Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08dad9c4a42040e6b4df119638bf4f38b758be08.png)

What's In The Mod:

-The dappled forest includes a new type of trees: The Poplar Trees!

-The "Poplar" wood set, with logs, planks, slabs, stairs, fences, and fence gates!

![The Poplar Wood Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbefa93fda467c7eff6dfaf17126d97b490965ad.png)

-Wool stairs and slabs!

![Wool Stair And Slab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ff7b0aa1b8aaf14f71357a3f2b900586894085b.png)

-The "Abandoned Camp" structure!

![The Abandoned Camp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cc8b1dc39711955fe1670ef09c5495d5c566617.png)

How To Find The Biome:

After you download the mod and create a world with it, the biome will automatically appear in your world, you just have to search! (or use the /locate biome command to find it)

More Information:

The mod is still work in progress, and i am trying to make the biome as close to the official sneak peak as possible, right now it does not have much, but stay tuned for more updates!

And with that: Hitsomni Signing out!
